npcs.name: Ivo
memory: arrived in the valley as a builder
came ashore at the landing — the last town he built for finished its walls and then argued about them for a year, and he wanted to build where the arguing came before the walls

npcs.name: Odile
memory: arrived in the valley as a trader

came ashore at the landing — two valleys running have voted themselves a market and died before minting a coin, and she boarded because a market needs somebody who wants it more than they want to be right

feed.text: Odile: “You cannot trade what you cannot spare, so first we make sure there is a spare. After that: the first coin this valley mints will pass through my hand, and I will tell you exactly what it was worth.”

Brant: “Everything you will want in a year is behind iron. A mill wants a saw, a saw is a blade, a blade is a seam and a fire. I am for the shortest road to the seam, and I will dig it before anybody votes on it.”
Hazel: “A week of food is a week of weather. The first vote I win here will be about food, and I intend to win it before anyone is hungry, not after.”
Liss: “Six trees within a stone's throw and the lake at our backs. I can work with that.”
Ivo: “Houses first, then a mill, then whatever we vote. And we eat before we vote — I have gone hungry on a good site before, and a good site does not fill you.”

The landing went to a vote on the water — Ivo for the timber shore; Liss for the timber shore; Hazel for the berry cove; Brant for the far timber shore; Odile for the berry cove. the timber shore took the boat, the boat chose — the votes tied.
Five of you came ashore with a boat, four logs and a week of food. Nobody else is here, and nobody else is coming.

beats.title: You have landed
body: Five of you, a boat, four logs and a week of food. A wooded coast, a lake, stone in the uplands, and nothing else at all — no roads, no shelter, and nobody coming: the boat’s whole company is named, and it has sailed.
You can raise a house. That is the only thing this settlement knows how to build. Everything else it will have to decide it wants.
